authorityModel: VISUAL-SAFE DERIVED CUSTOMER OUTPUTS WITH SOURCE/CONTEXT PROVENANCE
keyDecision: All PFIG IDs may be produced, but visual permission does not create a universal personality scale. Each PFIG consumes an explicitly governed source-scoped, customer-confirmed, context-scoped or owner-mapped output.

pfigAuthority.name: PROFILE-DIMENSION-MAP
pfigAuthority.customerMeaning: Profile evidence by admitted visual lens and original source lane.
rules: never aggregate heterogeneous instruments into one master dimension score

pfigAuthority.name: PROFILE-PATTERN-RADAR
pfigAuthority.customerMeaning: Source-aware pattern radar. Each series belongs to one admitted source/instrument; axes are owner-defined navigation lenses or the native self-assessment domains.
rules: native raw range/provenance available on demand

pfigAuthority.name: PROFILE-STRENGTH-COST-MAP
pfigAuthority.customerMeaning: Observed resources and costs, not fixed strengths/weaknesses.
rules: strength side requires HELPS_ME/BOTH or source-native explicitly positive resource semantics
cost side requires COSTS_ME/BOTH or admitted tension/friction evidence
never infer strength from high score or weakness from low score

pfigAuthority.name: PROFILE-CONTEXT-VARIATION
pfigAuthority.customerMeaning: How the same Profile evidence appears across explicitly recorded contexts.
rules: context labels must come from customer/reality evidence
no stable context-dependent personality type inferred
single-context data renders one context plus UNKNOWN for unobserved contexts

pfigAuthority.name: PROFILE-CONVERGENCE-DIVERGENCE
pfigAuthority.customerMeaning: Owner-governed projection of cross-source agreement, divergence, context dependence or unknown.

pfigAuthority.name: PROFILE-WORK-MAP
pfigAuthority.customerMeaning: Work interest and observed work expression.
dataBasis: sourceScopedDimensions where explicitly mapped to WORK_INTEREST_EXPRESSION
rules: customer work observations may add expression evidence

pfigAuthority.name: PROFILE-RELATIONSHIP-MAP
pfigAuthority.customerMeaning: Relationship interaction evidence and observation targets.

pfigAuthority.name: PROFILE-DECISION-MAP
pfigAuthority.customerMeaning: Current decision evidence across planning, risk awareness, decision discipline, relevant task evidence and Current Reality observations.
rules: customer label must use decision evidence/current decision pattern rather than fixed decision type

pfigAuthority.name: PROFILE-REALITY-BRIDGE
pfigAuthority.customerMeaning: Bridge from Profile evidence to Current Reality and admitted observation questions.
rules: Current Reality may contextualize but not prove/disprove source model
